source: logs/latest.log; runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园与竞赛实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Jacob (2026-09-03 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Jacob

messages.context: Jacob 的农业竞赛开始时的广播
messages.text: My contest has started!
messages.gloss: 沿用农业竞赛的既有玩法称呼,Jacob 人名不翻译。
messages.zh: 我的农业竞赛开始了!

messages.context: 农业等级不到 10 级时的招呼
messages.text: Howdy!
messages.zh: 嘿,你好啊!

messages.raw: I organize farming contests once every few days!
messages.text: I organize farming contests once every few days!
messages.zh: 我隔几天就办一场农业竞赛!

messages.text: You need Farming X to participate! :)
messages.gloss: Farming X 是农业技能 10 级,按「农业 10 级」的既定写法;高亮段落只放等级本身。
messages.zh: 你得先把农业练到 10 级才能参赛! :)

messages.context: 农业到 10 级后第一次对话
messages.text: Howdy! Fine day eh?
messages.zh: 嘿! 今天天气不错啊?

messages.raw: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?
messages.text: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?
messages.zh: 你该不会就是那位了不起的农夫吧,啊?

messages.text: You wouldn't happen to be one mighty fine farmer eh?
messages.gloss: Wiki 写法(多一个 fine),未实测。
messages.zh: 你该不会就是那位了不起的好农夫吧,啊?

messages.raw: Well, well! I coordinate a §efarming contest §revery few SkyBlock days, eh?
messages.text: Well, well! I coordinate a farming contest every few SkyBlock days, eh?
messages.zh: 好嘛,好嘛! 每隔几个空岛日,我就张罗一场农业竞赛,懂吧?

segments.zh: 好嘛,好嘛! 每隔几个空岛日,我就张罗一场

messages.raw: Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!
messages.text: Check ye calendar eh? Or better yet, click me to learn more, eh!
messages.zh: 去翻翻你的日历呗? 或者干脆再点我一下,我细说给你听!

messages.context: Finnegan 当市长时竞赛开始的广播
messages.text: Finnegan is forcing me to be more lenient with rankings...
messages.zh: Finnegan 非逼着我把名次划得宽松点……

messages.context: 竞赛开始时佩戴 Anita 饰品
messages.text: Your Anita's Talisman is giving you +5 %s Fortune during the contest!
messages.gloss: Wiki 写作 [crop] Fortune,作物名走词表;「Anita's Talisman」是饰品名,只翻通用词 Talisman → 护符。
messages.zh: 你的 Anita 护符在本场竞赛中为你提供 +5 %s时运!

messages.text: Your Anita's Ring is giving you +15 %s Fortune during the contest!
messages.zh: 你的 Anita 戒指在本场竞赛中为你提供 +15 %s时运!

messages.text: Your Anita's Artifact is giving you +25 %s Fortune during the contest!
messages.zh: 你的 Anita 神器在本场竞赛中为你提供 +25 %s时运!

messages.context: 竞赛期间超过个人最佳时
messages.raw: §d§lPERSONAL BEST§f! You've surpassed your previous record of §e%1$s §fitems collected in the §a%2$s Contest§f!
messages.text: PERSONAL BEST! You've surpassed your previous record of %1$s items collected in the %2$s Contest!
messages.gloss: 英文先说数量后说作物,中文按语序调换,靠 order 让两个高亮段各自带着颜色走。
messages.zh: 个人最佳! 你刷新了自己在%2$s竞赛中的纪录,此前是 %1$s 个!

segments.text: ! You've surpassed your previous record of

messages.text: Keep it up!
messages.zh: 再接再厉!

messages.text: The Farming Contest is over!
messages.zh: 农业竞赛结束了!

messages.raw: §fLet me count the final results eh?
messages.text: Let me count the final results eh?
messages.zh: 让我来算算最终成绩,啊?

messages.text: Let me count the results eh?
messages.gloss: Wiki 另一种写法(少了 final),未实测。
messages.zh: 让我来算算成绩,啊?

messages.raw: You placed in the §c§l%1$s §fbracket in the §a%2$s Contest§f!
messages.text: You placed in the %1$s bracket in the %2$s Contest!

placeholders.desc: 名次档位 BRONZE / SILVER / GOLD / PLATINUM / DIAMOND,译名走 _shared/Terms.json 的 medal 类型(铜牌/银牌/金牌/白金/钻石)

messages.gloss: 档位颜色随档位变(铜是 §c),分段只定边界。
messages.zh: 你在%2$s竞赛中进入了%1$s档!

messages.text: You collected %1$s items! PERSONAL BEST!
messages.zh: 你收集了 %1$s 个! 个人最佳!

messages.text: You collected %1$s items!
messages.zh: 你收集了 %1$s 个!

messages.text: Your previous Personal Best was %1$s.
messages.zh: 你此前的个人最佳是 %1$s 个。

messages.text: Your Personal Bests perk is now granting you +%1$s☘ %2$s Fortune!
messages.zh: 你的个人最佳天赋现在为你提供 +%1$s☘ %2$s时运!

messages.raw: You didn't earn a medal, but you may claim a participation reward in the §a%1$s Contest§f!
messages.text: You didn't earn a medal, but you may claim a participation reward in the %1$s Contest!
messages.zh: 你没拿到奖牌,不过可以领一份%1$s竞赛的参与奖!

segments.text: You didn't earn a medal, but you may claim a participation reward in the
segments.zh: 你没拿到奖牌,不过可以领一份

messages.raw: Come see me in the §aHub §fto claim your reward!
messages.text: Come see me in the Hub to claim your reward!
messages.zh: 来大厅找我领奖!

messages.text: Uh oh! Couldn't figure out how well ya did!
messages.zh: 糟糕! 我没算出来你这场发挥得怎么样!

messages.text: Come see me in the hub anyway!
messages.zh: 不管怎样,来大厅找我一趟吧!

messages.raw: §fHowdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
messages.text: Howdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
messages.zh: 嘿! 你这谷仓真不赖啊? 好小伙,能给我弄点小麦来不?

messages.raw: §fThanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?
messages.text: Thanks a lot matey. That'll help ye prepare my next farming contest eh?
messages.zh: 多谢了伙计。这下我下一场农业竞赛就好准备了,啊?

messages.text: Gosh darn it matey, can't believe ya do me like that, eh?
messages.zh: 哎哟我的天,伙计,你真忍心这么对我,啊?

messages.text: ✆ Howdy!
messages.zh: ✆ 嘿,你好啊!

messages.text: ✆ You want my abithingy eh?
messages.zh: ✆ 你想要我那个啥……Abi 什么玩意儿的联系方式?

messages.text: ✆ Ma' always told me to worry of stuff I don't understand.
messages.zh: ✆ 我妈总说,搞不懂的东西要多留个心眼。

messages.text: ✆ I'm far from stupid, don't get me wrong, eh.
messages.zh: ✆ 别误会,我可一点都不傻,啊。

messages.text: ✆ I simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
messages.zh: ✆ 我只是更喜欢简简单单地过日子,懂吧?

messages.text: ✆ Ya sure can add my contact, against 10 Jacob's Ticket, eh?
messages.zh: ✆ 加我当然行,拿 10 张 Jacob 的票券来换,啊?

messages.context: 没带够 10 张 Jacob 的票券

messages.text: ✆ Ya won't call me too often, eh?
messages.zh: ✆ 你不会老给我打电话吧,啊?

messages.text: ✆ Howdy, just telling ya there are contests today for %1$s, %2$s, and %3$s!
messages.zh: ✆ 嘿,跟你说一声,今天的竞赛作物是%1$s、%2$s和%3$s!

messages.text: ✆ Hope to see ya farming!
messages.zh: ✆ 希望能看到你下地干活!

messages.context: 一次领取超过 28 场竞赛的奖励
messages.text: Hot diggity, that's a lot of medals! I gave ya some rewards, speak with me if you're interested in the rest.
messages.zh: 好家伙,这么多奖牌! 我先给你发一部分奖励,剩下的想要就再来找我。

messages.context: 社区 Wiki 收录的大厅新手引导台词
messages.text: Howdy
messages.gloss: Wiki 原文,未伪造游戏内颜色 raw;分段在运行时采样实际文字颜色。
messages.zh: 嘿,你好啊!

note: Jacob,农舍和花园里主持农业竞赛的老农夫,Finnegan 市长的姐夫/妹夫。对玩家是热情的乡下大叔口吻,几乎句句带「eh?」「ye」「matey」这种口头禅;中文用「嘿」「啊」「伙计」这类语气词还原,不写成书面通知。竞赛结算那几句是系统性播报,事实(名次档位、数量、作物)一个字不能改。竞赛结束的播报在大厅和花园里都会出现,同一句只在这一个文件里写一份。
source_note: 「You wouldn't happen to be one mighty farmer eh?」实测没有 Wiki 里的 fine 一词,两家 Wiki 都写 fine;差一个词,两种写法都保留。
「Howdy」Wiki 无感叹号,实测有;以实测为准。
